description: Result.actual_output is typed as a string in spec/schemas/resultset.json. A producer that emits a multi-turn transcript or a list of chunks as a JSON array here (instead of joining it into one string, or putting the structured form in metadata) produces a document the JSON Schema rejects -- and both reference validators used to accept it anyway, because they only type-checked required fields. Found by ChelseaKR in ChelseaKR/gauntlet PR #76. A conformance implementation MUST REJECT this document.
